command: Human A3GALT2 retains glycosyltransferase/hexosyltransferase activity, contributes to glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and has LacNAc-specific activity. Evaluate each separately and interpret the existing NOT for GO:0001962 rather than erasing it. Reconcile PMID:18630988 human-domain chimera negatives with PMID:23378701 reconstructed-human-ORF weak positives in CHO cells. Inspect exact construct sequences, substrates, assay sensitivity and ancestral catalytic specificity; absence of an endogenous human assay is not proof of inactivity, and a positive different substrate does not establish LacNAc activity.
